                            STATEMENT

                        OF THE STATE OF KUWAIT


                               DELIVRED BY

                   THE REPRESENTATIVE OF HIS HIGHNESS

                SHEIKH NAWAF AL-AHMAD AL-JABER AL-SABAH

                       AMIR OF THE STATE OF KUWAIT



              HIS HIGHNESS SHEIKH AHMAD NAWAF AL-AHMAD AL-SABAH

                              PRIME MINISTER





                             BEFORE THE

                7711 SESSION OF THE UNITED NATIONS GENERAL ASSEMBLY

                       THURSDAY, 22 SEPTEMBER 2022





                       UNITED NATIONS HEADQUARTERS


                           NEW YORK

Your Excellency, President of the General Assembly

Your Excellency, Secretary General of the United Nations

Your Highnesses, Excellencies Heads of Delegations,



 Ladies and Gentlemen,



THE PEACE, MERCY AND BLESSINGS OF ALLAH BE UPON YOU


               It pleases me at the outset to congratulate Your Excellency personally, and to
congratulate your friendly country Hungary, on your election as President of the 77"
Session of the United Nations General Assembly, and to assure you of our total support
in everything that would facilitate the discharge of your tasks.

     On this occasion,     | also would like to express our sincerest gratitude for the efforts
of your predecessor, His Excellency Mr. Abdullah Shahid, on assuming the tasks of the
presidency of the previous session.

                                   | am also pleased in this occasion to pay tribute to the great and appreciated efforts
exerted by His Excellency, the Secretary General, in leading this inveterate Organization
under sensitive and delicate circumstances our world  is witnessing, basing his work on
achieving the  lofty message of the United Nations, armed with the provisions of  its
Charter, centered around the maintenance of international peace and security.

       Mr. President;

      The historic path of the workings of the United Nations, over the course of almost
eight decades, will lead us to arrive at key facts, that this Organization was faced with
changing events of formidable challenges and chronic crises the world has encountered.

     And whereas the multiplicity and diversity of the kinds of challenges and dangers
that humanity faces, starting from the spread of deadly epidemics, the proliferation of
weapons of mass destruction, the growing phenomenon of terrorism,  in addition to the
threats related to natural disasters, climate change, poverty, and the rise in the frequency
of caveats of food insecurity, require international cooperation; away from the logic of
 unilateral solutions. This is where this Organization had the most prominent role in dealing
with  all emergency and chronic risks, which came through the initiative of its Secretary
General, entitled,“Our Common Agenda”, supportive of achieving the goals of sustainable
development according  to more comprehensive foundations,  that take  into account
addressing the sets of obstacles, and puts forward innovative scalable solutions to chart
a clearer future. In this regard,

we renew the adherence of the State of Kuwait to the international multilateral system,
and to the principle and aims of the Charter of the United Nations, in what guarantees the
 realization of the  lofty message of this Organization,  in serving the entire humanity,


                                                                            2

fostering the logic of mediation and preventive diplomacy, to spare future generations
from the scourge of wars and conflicts.

       Mr. President;

     The world  is watching with great interest the accelerating developments  in the
situation  in Ukraine, and  its related complexities, whose effects and repercussions on
security and  stability have become tangible. Here we  affirm our principled and firm
position of adhering to the principles of international law and of the United Nations
Charter, which reject the use of force, or the threat of the use of force, or even waving
such a threat to resolve conflicts between countries. We emphasize the importance of
adhering to the principles enshrined in the Charter, and in this regard, the State of Kuwait
supports all UN endeavors and  all other international efforts to de-escalate and cease-
fire,  in order  to  find a peaceful  solution  to  this  crisis, because the experiences  of
contemporary history have proven that peace, and  its related mechanisms of mediation
and dialogue, was and  still  is the optimum choice for resolving conflicts, no matter how
long they last.

       Mr. President;

      The Question of Palestine occupies a central and pivotal role  in our Arab and
Muslim worlds. Tensions and instability shall remain prevalent in our region, unless the
proud  Palestinian people obtain  all  their legitimate  rights, and  Israel, the occupation
authority ceases  its continuous violations of international humanitarian  law. Here we
emphasize the need to expend efforts to re-launch the negotiations within a fixed time
frame, in order to achieve a just and comprehensive peace, according to the references
of the peace process, the resolutions of international legitimacy, and the Arab Peace
 Initiative, that would end the Israeli occupation, and the establishment of an independent
Palestinian State, with East Jerusalem as  its capital, along the borders prior to   4 June
1967.


       Mr. President;

      The absence of unanimity and international will from one side, and the frequency
of external intervention, on the other, were a major a reason, for the continuation of the
Syrian crisis that entered  its twelfth year, reflecting one of the ugliest images of human
suffering. Here we renew our firm position, that there is no military solution to this crisis,
and stress the need for action to reach a political settlement, in accordance with relevant
Security Council resolutions, particularly resolution 2254 (2015), and in what realizes the
hopes and aspirations of the brotherly Syrian people.

         In the context of the crisis in the brotherly Yemen, we renew our welcome of the
truce agreement between the Yemeni sides, and emphasize the need to execute all of its
provisions. We commend the efforts of the Special Envoy of the Secretary General for
Yemen, in strengthening compliance with the truce, which came about under the auspices
of the United Nations, and within the context of the peace  initiative announced by the
sisterly Kingdom  of Saudi Arabia  in March 2021,  to end  this  crisis, and  reach  a
comprehensive political solution based on the three agreed upon references, which are


                                                                                      3

the Initiative of the GCC and its implementation mechanism, the outcomes of the National
Dialogue, and the resolutions of the Security Council, particularly resolution 2216.

       At that same regional  level, and proceeding from basic premises related to the
rules of good neighborliness, contained in the Charter of the United Nations, we renew
our call to the Islamic Republic of Iran to take serious trust-building measures, to start a
dialogue built upon the respect of the sovereignty of states, and non-intervention  in their
internal affairs, as well to reduce tensions  in the Gulf region, and preserve the safety,
security and freedom of navigation from any threats.

       Mr. President;
      The State of Kuwait is approaching the celebration of its 60th Anniversary ofjoining
the United Nations, through which  it lived and interacted with numerous experiences and
stations the world have witnessed     , most outstanding of them was the experience of the
invasion and  liberation  of my country, which also became a success story  for this
Organization,  in its strict implementation of the resolutions of international legitimacy, on
top of which were the relevant outputs of the Security Council and the General Assembly.
This has increased the belief in the inevitability of multilateral international action, and the
importance  of  its  activation,  in what corresponds  to  achieving  the  ambitions and
aspirations in a world where security, stability and prosperity prevail, and where the voice
of the peoples is the main compass.

       Kuwait  is living  its democratic wedding represented  in the  in the parliamentary
elections of the National Assembly, and based on  lofty and clear directions from the
 political leadership, the Government has provided  all the means and harnessed  all the
 possibilities available to  all senior officials  in  official authorities, and directed them to
sense the needs of the citizens and endeavorto resolve all obstacles within the framework
 of the law. This emanated of the belief that any effort for development will not have a
 payoff or the expected feasibility,  in the absence of the involvement of the citizen and
 listening to his voice. This is in line with our multilateral vision envisaged to create a new
 Kuwait in the year 2035.

       Mr. President;

          In the coming month of November, our Arab region will witness a world sporting
 event, represented by the FIFA World Cup, organized by sisterly State of Qatar, which is
 in pace with the economic and cultural renaissance  it is witnessing, and confirms its ability
 to host such major tournaments. We wish them exceptional success, being the first Arab
 and Muslim country to host such an international competition.


           The Peace, Mercy and Blessings of Allah be Upon You.
